sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Reserve Expert is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Come on in, brother! I've got a job for you. There's a couple soldier barracks at the Reserve base, and according to regulations, they should have armories and storage rooms inside. I need to know what's left in there, whether it's worth putting together a serious team or if someone's already cleaned the place out. Can you head over there and scout it out? And just so I'm not taking your word for nothing, bring me something from there. I'll take a look."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must reach Loyalty Level 3 with Ragman to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Check the first armory in the eastern barracks (Black Pawn) on Reserve
- Check the duty room in the eastern barracks (Black Pawn) on Reserve
- Check the second armory in the eastern barracks (Black Pawn) on Reserve
- Check the first armory in the southern barracks (White Pawn) on Reserve
- Check the second armory in the southern barracks (White Pawn) on Reserve
- Hand over the gear found in the rooms
  - (Optional) Locate and obtain any Russian gear in the armory rooms

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Hmm, not exactly perfect, but I can still sell something like this. Thanks, brother!"
